Overview

Trenčín is a city in Trenčín Region with a population of 55,593. One of Slovakia’s most picturesque towns, dominated by the magnificent Trenčín Castle perched on a cliff, with a charming old town and a vibrant cultural scene. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
